messages:
maya chen: Heads-up — bringing qbench qx2b-int4 into verification. Latency/cost win looks good, but golden-check failed: ~120 regressions on promptset-A. Suspect tokenizer v2 + dedupe mismatch. Need a short relabel + golden refresh plan so we don't ship a quality regression.

samir: can you paste top failing sample ids and a quick metric snapshot? :eyes: 

maya chen: quick dump of the top 12 fail rows (id, orig_score, int4_score, delta):
```
38591234, 0.92, 0.61, -0.31
38591278, 0.88, 0.59, -0.29
38591300, 0.90, 0.63, -0.27
38591411, 0.81, 0.55, -0.26
38591599, 0.79, 0.54, -0.25
38591621, 0.85, 0.61, -0.24
38591733, 0.83, 0.60, -0.23
38591844, 0.86, 0.64, -0.22
38591955, 0.87, 0.66, -0.21
38592066, 0.84, 0.64, -0.20
38592177, 0.80, 0.61, -0.19
38592288, 0.82, 0.63, -0.19
```
Most of these look like omission/hallucination or tokenization edge splits. Also a bigger long-tail of low-delta but noisy cases.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-4235 — "qbench qx2b-int4: promptset-A regressions". Assigned to eng-ml.

jinwoo: I can run a dedupe pass with fuzzyhash threshold=0.82 and remap tokenizer v1->v2 tokenwalk to see overlap. Which samplebank slice?

maya chen: use samplebank-prod-v3 shards 56-60, and please keep a separate copy (no overwrite). CLI: `sbctl export --shards 56-60 --tag qx2b-int4-fuzz`

leo: I'll mobilize relabelers. Proposed annotation spec: 3 labels: OK / BAD / UNCLEAR. If BAD, add reason tag: [hallucination, omission, factual_error, tokenization_split]. Ask labelers to note tokenization artifacts (merge/split).

elle: I can take the first batch of 40 high-risk samples from the top fails and start labeling. ETA EOD tomorrow.

tara: Can we run an A/B canary route so product sees int4 on 5% traffic for a couple hours after relabels? Example route config: { "route": "/generate", "percent": 5, "model": "qx2b-int4", "fallback": "q4b" }

maya chen: yes — plan: 1) jin runs dedupe+token-remap and posts updated delta list 2) leo/elle label 40 high-risk + 100 stratified samples 3) update golden set (replace 40 disputed with reviewed labels) 4) spin 5% canary route for 2h and run eval harness. If metrics pass, escalate rollout.

samir: small ask — when you update golden, tag commit with `golden/qx2b-int4-1767` and include the eval promptset diff. I can take the regression triage after dedupe pass at 09:00 PT tomorrow.

jinwoo: started dedupe job now (queued on infra). Will post logs and a CSV with remapped token counts.

ops-bot: Dedup job queued (job id dedupe-7761). ETA ~45m.

leo: scheduling 2 labelers for 4h shift tomorrow morning. I'll drop the detailed annotation sheet into the labeling queue and link here. :thumbsup:

maya chen: thanks. also note — if we see a systematic pattern (token split on contractions, html-entity mismap) we may need to add a small tokenizer preprocessor for qx2b-int4, not just relabel. We'll surface that in postmortem if it shows up.

elle: ack. labeling template received. starting with the top 40 tomorrow.

samir: cool. I'll re-run the regression scorer after jin's dedupe output and post results here. If we still see >15 high-confidence fails, we pause canary and investigate deeper.

maya chen: perfect. Thanks everyone — keep updates in this thread. :white_check_mark:
